title: The Gothic Bible: LegOst Digital Editions
description:
TEI-encoded diplomatic-interpretative digital editions of the witnesses to the Gothic Bible, produced within the PRIN 2022 project LegOst – The Textual Legacy of the Ostrogoths in Italy: The Gothic Bible and Other Texts (PI: Carla Falluomini) and published on Archivum Gothicum.

Volume 1 comprises the following witnesses:

  • CArg: Codex Argenteus and Speyer fragment (Matthew, John, Luke, Mark)
  • CCar: Codex Carolinus (Romans, Gothic–Latin)
  • CGis: Codex Gissensis, lost (Luke, Gothic–Latin)
  • CAmbC: ms. Ambrosianus C (Matthew, palimpsest)
  • CAmbD: ms. Ambrosianus D (Nehemiah, palimpsest)

The release contains the TEI XML editions (one file per biblical book and per witness), the manuscript descriptions in Italian and English, the encoding documentation, the Python scripts used to convert the editors' Word transcriptions into TEI XML, and the customisations made to EVT 3 for the publication on Archivum Gothicum. Facsimile images of the manuscripts and the EVT 3 application are not included.
